attributes.title: Level 2

subgroups.name: Discover

steps.text: Watch this video to learn about using loops in your projects to run a chunk of code over and over and over again!

questions.hint: What does a loop do in a project?
questions.title: [Select one] What is a loop?

answers.text: A chunk of code that makes a sprite spin around the screen.
When the computer forgets to run a piece of code and has to loop back to it.
A chunk of code that repeats until a specific condition is met.
Code that sets the speed and direction of a sprite.

questions.correctResponse: Remember a loop can turn 1 cookie into 1 million cookies, yum!

questions.hint: Which code block repeats a chunk of code until a specific condition is met?
questions.title: [Select one] Select the code block that is a loop.
questions.correctResponse: This code block loops a chunk of code for every x milliseconds that the game is running.

questions.hint: What happens when a sprite’s velocity is set?
questions.title: [Select one] How might you use velocity in your code?

answers.text: To set how quickly a loop runs
To set how quickly your program runs
To generate a background image of velociraptors in the city

questions.correctResponse: Remember velocity is what helped us move the cookies to the table.

questions.hint: The velocity determines which two values of a projectile?
questions.title: [Select one] Velocity is the _______ and ________ of something moving.
questions.correctResponse: Think of projectiles, you can adjust both the vx and vy values.

subgroups.title: Loops!
subgroups.introduction: Watch this video to learn about using loops in your projects to run a chunk of code over and over and over again!

attributes.description: You’ve reached Level 2 of Yellow Belt! In this level, you’ll learn about loops, which are chunks of code that repeat a sequence of instructions. Here are the achievements you’ll unlock in Level 2:

badges.title: Around and Around
badges.description: Use loops to repeat code in a project.

badges.title: The Times, They Are A-Changin’
badges.description: Use a game update loop to repeat actions in a project.

badges.title: Bouncing off the Walls
badges.description: Set a sprite to bounce on walls in a project.

badges.title: Pew Pew
badges.description: Launch a projectile from a specific sprite.

badges.title: Button Masher
badges.description: Use an event triggered by the A button in a project.

badges.title: I Like to Move It Move It
badges.description: Use velocity to make a sprite move on its own.
